# Parley v0.1.29

This release adds an explicit option to bypass vendor permission checks inside
local container panes. Host panes keep their existing permission controls.

## Container permission bypass

- In a Claude Code or Codex container launch review, select **Bypass vendor
  permissions (container only)** before checking the image. It is off by default;
  existing saved container settings keep their previous mode.
- Codex receives `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`; Claude receives
  `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Codex no longer needs its inner sandbox in
  this mode. Bypass cannot be combined with legacy Landlock.
- The selected permission profile's restrictions are not applied. The agent can
  change mounted project files and shared Git metadata, run commands, use the
  network and access its saved vendor login without the usual vendor prompts.
- Docker retains the same mounts, non-root user, dropped capabilities and
  no-new-privileges setting. The Docker socket and host vendor login are not
  mounted. Shared Git hooks or executable configuration can still cause commands
  to run on the Mac during later host Git operations, without another Parley
  review.
- The pane shows **CONTAINER · BYPASS**. Status Center and Team Sessions show
  the selected mode. Team approval can bind it separately for each container
  vendor; agents cannot choose or change it through `team add`.
- Native preparation and activation bind the exact reviewed mode. Returning a
  pane to host execution restores its normal permission profile. Requested host
  command runs keep their separate native approval.

## Image checks and validation

The image check still verifies the required Linux utilities. With bypass
selected, it checks vendor startup without demanding a working inner sandbox.
Real OrbStack probes accepted both vendors' flags using `--version`, without
project files, login or model calls. Interactive signed-in bypass sessions and
the new native toggle still need a person-supervised walkthrough.

Without bypass, Codex's default sandbox remains unavailable in the tested
OrbStack configuration. The separately selected legacy Landlock option remains
available for compatible images but is deprecated. No automatic fallback is
introduced.

Agent protocol is now 31. Existing agent panes need a person-authorized restart
to receive the changed launch instructions; Parley never restarts them silently.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
